data.gender_notes: Rujaynah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rujaynah is a name that symbolizes a beautiful and peaceful place in Paradise. It is a name that evokes feelings of serenity and tranquility. The name Rujaynah carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rujaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rujaynah is associated with the concept of Jannah (Paradise), a place of eternal peace and happiness.
data.etymology: Rujaynah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rujaynah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rujaynah holds deep cultural significance for many Muslims as it is a name mentioned in the Hadiths, which are the traditions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). In one Hadith, while describing Paradise, the Prophet (pbuh) mentioned a place called Rujaynah, referring to its beauty, lushness, and abundance. This name serves as a reminder of the Islamic belief in an eternal and rewarding paradise for the righteous.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rujaynah carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it is a symbol of divine reward and blessing. In Islamic tradition, everyone who enters paradise is given seven gates to enter, and the gate named Al-Rujyaan is known to be the most beautiful and honored. As the name suggests, it represents a place of peace, rest, and eternal happiness. Muslims often use this name in their Prayers, seeking its blessings, and using it as a reminder to live righteously in order to enter paradise.
